(Roy Kim) - (When Spring Comes) Official Video
Release 2024.03.04 6PM (KST)
The spring I once knew has come and gone. The flighty youth which shook me so easily has now shifted my focus to the ones who remain unshaken by my side. Though less adventurous you may say, the four seasons filled with gratitude and contentment are for sure, the better life I want to lead. May yours too be merry and bright.
